stops.name: Knightstown
stops.detail: In addition, between April and September, there is a ferry connection from Reenard Point to Knightstown, the most important settlement on the island.

stops.name: Glanleam House
stops.detail: In the northeast of the island is "Glanleam House" (Teach Ghleann Laoim), whose garden features subtropical plants.

stops.name: Menhir von Glanleam
stops.detail: The Standing Stone of Glanleam stands in the middle of a fort, near Cromwell Point and its lighthouse on one of the northern tips of Valentia Island.
